character: Main Carroz village at 1,140m. Lively snow front with shops, bars, restaurants. Direct gondola to Grand Massif (265km). Aquacime wellness centre (1,500sqm, heated outdoor pool 30°C). Rail toboggan from Kedeuze gondola. Family-friendly.
activities_nearby: Aquacime (heated outdoor pool, spa, sauna). Rail toboggan. Ice skating. Bowling. Cinema. Dog sledding. Paragliding. 265km Grand Massif.
